title: Talking about past experiences / Ukuthetha ngeminikelo yeshona
bridge: Ngesi, ukuthetha ngeminikelo yeshona siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'pretérito perfecto compuesto' ('he visitado') okanye 'pretérito indefinido' ('visité'), kuhlukaniswe yingi ukuthi isikhathi sikhona isibambisane noma hhayi. NgesiNgisi, ukuthetha ngeminikelo yobomi siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'present perfect' ('have visited'), okungekho isilinganiso esisodwa ngesi. Inhloso yokuqala yikuthi ngesiNgisi siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'have + participio' ukuze kuthathwe imisebenzi ekusekelwe isikhathi esingeke sisayiwa, ngakho-ke ngesi siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'pretérito indefinido' ukuze kuthathwe imisebenzi ekusekelwe isikhathi esiyisiqingatha. Qaphela: ngesiNgisi awusekho ukusebenza no-'present perfect' nabalulekile be-time expressions like 'yesterday' okanye 'last year'.
rule: Ukuze kuthathwe iminikelo yeshona ngesiNgisi, siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'present perfect' nobungo: have/has + past participle. Liyasebenzwa ukuze: 1) iminikelo yobomi engakhethi isikhathi (I have visited Paris), 2) imisebenzi eyenzekile eshonapho iyene indima ngoku (She has lost her keys), 3) nabalulekile abanjani 'ever', 'never', 'already', 'yet', 'just', 'before'. Ukuze kuthathwe umthelela, siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'have not' (haven't) okanye 'has not' (hasn't). Ukuze kubuze, siyaxhasa ukusebenza nobufakazi obukhulu (Have you ever...?). Ukuze kubuze ngeminikelo, siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'Have you ever + participio?' futhi siphendula ngokuthi 'Yes, I have' okanye 'No, I never have'. Awusekho ukusebenza no-'present perfect' nabalulekile be-time expressions (yesterday, last week, in 2010). Kulo mikhuba, siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'past simple' (visited, went). Ukubeka A2, kuyimphamba ukwazi ukusebenza ne-participios zezikhombisi ezingcono kakhulu (go-gone, eat-eaten, see-seen, have-had).

concept_examples.text: I have visited Mexico.
She has never eaten sushi.
Have you ever seen that movie?
concept_examples.translation: Ingabe uyibone lo mfihlo ngisho endaba?

concept_examples.text: We have already finished our homework.

common_error.explanation: Lolwazi lwenza ngenxa yokuthi ngesi kungavula ukuthi 'He visitado París ayer' kwizinhloso ezinye, kodwa ngesiNgisi 'present perfect' awusebenziswa nabalulekile be-time expressions like 'yesterday'. Ukuze isikhathi esiyisiqingatha eshonapho, kufanele ukusebenza no-'past simple' (visited). Uma akukho isikhathi esiyisiqingatha, kufanele ukusebenza no-'present perfect' (have visited). Khumbula: 'present perfect' + isikhathi esiyisiqingatha = okungavumelekile.

examples.original: Have you ever been to London?
examples.translation: Ingabe uye wemka eLondon ngisho endaba?
examples.note: Siyaxhasa ukusebenza no-'ever' emibuzweni ukuze kubuze ngeminikelo ekusekelwe isikhathi esingake sisayiwa.

examples.original: I have never tried Thai food.
examples.note: 'Never' siyekwa phakathi no-'have' ne-participio, futhi ilinga 'ngisho endaba' ekuphileni.

examples.original: She has never flown in a plane.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ˈnɛvər floʊn ɪn ə pleɪn/
examples.note: Khumbula ukuthi 'flown' iyeyiparticipio ye-'fly', isikhombisi esingavumbulwa.
'Already' siyasebenzwa ekuthethweni futhi ilinga 'ngokuqala' (ngaphandle kwesikhathi esingakholelwa).

examples.original: Have you bought the tickets yet?
examples.note: 'Yet' siyasebenzwa emibuzweni nemithethweni, ekupheleni komthetho, futhi ilinga 'ngakho'.

examples.original: We haven't finished our project yet.
examples.note: Ekuthathweni, 'yet' siyekwa ekupheleni futhi ilinga ukuthi into ayikwenzekile ngakuqala.
'Present perfect' siyasebenzwa engakhethi isikhathi esiyisiqingatha, ukuze kuthathwe iminikelo.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɛnt tə pəˈruː ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd nɪnˈtiːn/
examples.note: 'Past simple' siyasebenzwa nabalulekile be-time expressions like 'in 2019'.

examples.original: She has lived in Madrid for two years.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi hæz lɪvd ɪn məˈdrɪd fɔːr tuː jɪrz/
examples.translation: Yena uye wahlala eMadrid iminyaka emibili.
examples.note: 'Present perfect' siyasebenzwa no-'for' + isikhathi ukuze kuthathwe imisebenzi eyalandelana ngoku.
Ekusebenziseni no-'past simple', isikhombisi 'see' siyaguqulwa ku-'saw', futhi siyasebenzwa nabalulekile be-time expressions.

title: Making Plans and Arrangements / Ukwenza Izibonelo Nokubeka Izikhalo
bridge: NesiSpani siqubuka isikhathi esivela ngokuqukethwe noma isikhathi esizayo (kuza + infinitive) ukukhuluma ngamathuba. NgesiNgisi, ukwenza izibonelo nezikhalo sicelwa ngokuvamile 'present continuous' (I'm meeting) nezindaba eziqinile, nokuba 'be going to' (I'm going to visit) nezindaba ezinikeziwe. Qaphela: ngesiNgisi awusetshenziswa isikhathi esivela ngokuqukethwe nezindaba zakho eziyizayo, nakhuha nesiSpani ngemarhu ayeyiwakhona (okomisa. 'Ngizokuxhumana nawe kusasa' → 'I'll meet you tomorrow', hhayi 'I meet you'). Ngaphezu kwalokho, 'will' sicelwa ukwenza izinqumo ezinikeziwe, hhayi ukwenza izibonelo eziqinile.
rule:
Ukuwenza izibonelo nezikhalo ngesiNgisi ehlelo A2, usebenzisa lawa migaqo:

1. **Present continuous** (am/is/are + -ing): nezibonelo nezikhalo eziqinile, nekhadi nelapha. Okomisa. 'I'm seeing the doctor at 3.' (Ngizokuxhumana nomphakathi ngohorolo lwamathathu).

2. **Be going to** (am/is/are going to + infinitive): nezindaba noma izibonelo eziqhubekayo engazange zibekwe. Okomisa. 'We're going to visit our grandparents.' (Sinomqondo wokuxhumana nabazali).

3. **Will** (will + umthelela wesiNgisi): nezinqumo ezenziwe ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, ukusiza noma ukubeka izibonelo. Okomisa. 'I'll help you with that.' (Inqumo ezinikeziwe).

4. **Would like to** (would like to + infinitive): ukubiza noma izibonelo eziqhubekayo eziqhubekayo noma eziqhubekayo. Okomisa. 'Would you like to come to my party?'

Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi awusetshenziswa isikhathi esivela ngokuqukethwe nezindaba zakho eziyizayo (ngokungalungile nesiSpani kwangokwemivelaphi). Sebenzisa ngisho 'be going to' noma 'present continuous' nezibonelo.

NgesiNgisi, isikhathi esivela ngokuqukethwe asibonisi izindaba zakho eziyizayo; nezibonelo eziqinile kufanele usebenzise isikhathi esikhathini eside (I'm meeting) noma 'be going to' (I'm going to meet).

title: Giving advice and recommendations / Ukunika iziluleko nokwethula
bridge: Ngesi, ukunika iziluleko siyathusa isubjunktivi (I recommend you go, you should go). Ngesi, isubjunktivi asithunyelwa emva kwe-'recommend' okanye 'suggest'; siyathusa isikhalo esisodwa somshikashiko okanye inqaku + infinitive: 'I recommend you go', 'I suggest you try'. Nathi siyathusa 'should' (deberías) engajani kunokuthi 'must'. Umphutha onguqondayo yikukopa isubjunktivi sase-Spanish: 'I recommend that you go' iyaphula, kodwa 'I recommend you to go' yindlela ephulayo ngenxa yokuthi nge-English 'recommend' ayilandelwa yinfinitivo eno- 'to' uma kukhona inqaku.
rule:
Ukunika iziluleko nokwethula nge-English e-A2, usa lezi zikhalo ezikhomba:
1. **Should / Shouldn't + umshikashiko**: iziluleko eziphambili. Isibonelo: 'You should eat more vegetables.' 'You shouldn't stay up late.' (isimo esingaphuli). Ayichanjwa (he should, no he shoulds).
2. **You could + umshikashiko**: iziluleko ezinamandla okanye izinketho. Isibonelo: 'You could try yoga.'
3. **I recommend / I suggest + that + isikhombisi + umshikashiko** (ngaphandle kwe-'to' nangaphandle kwebhala lesubjunktivi). Isibonelo: 'I recommend that you see a doctor.' Nathi ungasetshenziswa igerundive: 'I recommend seeing a doctor.' okanye 'I suggest trying this.'
4. **How about + igerundive (-ing)?**: iziluleko eziphambili. Isibonelo: 'How about going for a walk?'
5. **Why don't you + umshikashiko?**: iziluleko ezinombuzo. Isibonelo: 'Why don't you take a break?'
Inothisi: Ungasetshenzisi 'must' ezilulekweni, kunesibonelo esikhulu; 'must' iyinkathalo. Ezilulekweni ezinamandla, usa 'could' okanye 'might'. Khumbula ukuthi emva kwe-'recommend' nokanye 'suggest', ungasetshenzisi 'to' emva kwenqaku: 'I recommend you to go' ayiphulaphula.

concept_examples.text: You should drink more water.
I recommend that you talk to the teacher.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌrekəˈmend ðæt juː tɔːk tə ðə ˈtiːtʃər/

concept_examples.translation: Yini na ukuthi uzenze lo msebenzi?

common_error.wrong: I recommend you to go to the doctor.
common_error.correct: I recommend that you go to the doctor.
common_error.correct_alt: I recommend going to the doctor.
common_error.explanation: Ngesi sithi 'ngiyakwethula ukuthi uhambe' okanye 'ngiyakwethula ukuhamba', kodwa nge-English, emva kwe-'recommend' ayilandelwa yinfinitivo eno-'to' emva kwenqaku. Isikhalo esiphula ngokwaphela 'recommend + that + isikhombisi + umshikashiko' okanye 'recommend + igerundive'. Lo mphutha uyenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abafundi bayaguqula ngokwenhloso 'ngiyakwethula wena ukuhamba' (eyazwakala njengo-'recommend you to go'). Ukuba ufuna ukuyekela lo mphutha, khumbula: 'recommend' isetshenziswa kanye no-'that' okanye no-'-ing', ngaso sonke isikhathi kanye no-'to'.

examples.note: Usa 'should' + umshikashiko. Ngesi, 'deberías' + infinitive.

examples.original: He shouldn't eat so much sugar.
examples.note: Isimo esingaphuli ngokuthi 'shouldn't' + umshikashiko. Ayichanjwa ngokwesiqotho sesithathu.

examples.original: We should study for the test.
examples.note: 'Should' ayiguquli ngokwesiqotho: I should, you should, we should.

examples.note: 'Could' iyethula iziluleko ezinamandla, ingajani kunokuthi 'should'.

examples.original: How about going to the park?
examples.note: Emva kwe-'How about' usetshenziswa igerundive (-ing).

title: Expressing opinions / Ukubeka izibonelo (Ngiyakholelwa, Ngiyakholelwa)
bridge: Ngesiporutheni, siyahlanganyela 'creo que' no 'pienso que' ngokuvamile, kodwa ngesiNgisi kunezigabaza: 'I think' iyabalulekile kakhulu futhi isetshenziswa ezibonweni nezakhiwo, ngenxa yokuthi 'I believe' ifakaza ukukholelwa okunamandla noma okwesiqondi. Umphutha onguqondayo ngokwengeziwe 'Yo pienso que' njengalokhu 'I think that', kodwa ngesiNgisi 'that' akusidingeka futhi kuhle kangaka ukuyekwa. Ngaphambi kwalokho, ngesiNgisi indima ngisho nezihloko zisebenza njengalokhu, akudingeki ukubeka izinkomba ezehlukahlukene njengalokhu 'in' noma 'of'. Khomba indima yamazwe futhi ungengi 'that' ngokwesidingo.
rule:
Ukubeka izibonelo ngesiNgisi ehlela A2, siyasetshenzisa izindima ezihlendelene:
- 'I think (that) + isisho' - ezibonweni nezakhiwo eziqondile.
- 'I believe (that) + isisho' - ezikholweni noma ezikholweni eziphathelene.
- 'In my opinion, + isisho' - okunamandla kakhulu, kodwa kuhle kangaka ngokubhalwa.
Ezinye izinhloso ezinamandla: 'I guess' (ngiyakholelwa) no 'I suppose' (ngiyakholelwa), bobabili bangenamandla.
Khumbula: 'that' akusidingeki futhi kuhle kangaka ukuyekwa ngokukhuluma. Indima ngisho nezihloko zisebenza njengalokhu: isibonelo + isisho + isibonelo. Ungasetshenzisi 'of' noma 'on' emva kwesi 'think/believe'. Akusisho 'I think in that', kodwa 'I think that' noma 'I think'. Izibonelo: 'I think (that) it's a good idea', 'I believe (that) he is right'. Emibuzweni engenamandla, ungabeka 'do you think?' ngasezantsi: 'It's a good idea, do you think?'

concept_examples.text: I think it's going to rain.
I believe you are right.
In my opinion, this movie is great.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən ðɪs ˈmuːvi ɪz ɡreɪt/

concept_examples.text: I guess we can try again.

common_error.wrong: I think in that it is good.
common_error.correct: I think that it is good.
common_error.explanation: Imputha iyavela ekuvulekeni kwesiPorutheni 'pienso en que', lapho isikhumbuzo 'en' siyatholakala ngesiNgisi. NgesiNgisi, amazwi 'think' no 'believe' asidingi isikhumbuzo ngaphambi kwesibonelo. Khuleka ukubeka 'in' noma 'on'. Ngaphambi kwalokho, 'that' akusidingeki, ngakho-ke ukusho 'I think it is good' kuhle kangaka futhi kuhle kangaka ngokukhuluma.

examples.note: Sethisa 'I think' + isisho ngaphandle kwesi 'that' ngokukhuluma.
Khumbula: ungengi 'that' ngokwesidingo.
Isisho 'be' siyatholakala ngokomshumayeli: I am, you are, we are.
Lapha 'believe in' kutshoe ukukholelwa kwinto, kodwa uma ubeka isibonelo usethisa 'believe that'.

examples.original: I believe that he is honest.
examples.note: Lapha 'that' akusidingeki futhi kuhle kangaka ngokubhalwa.

examples.original: I believe this is the best option.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðɪs ɪz ðə bɛst ˈɒpʃən/
examples.translation: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi lo uya ingcombolo ehle.
examples.note: Sethisa 'this' into ebalula; 'that' into ebalulekile.

examples.original: In my opinion, the food is delicious.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən ðə fuːd ɪz dɪˈlɪʃəs/
examples.note: Lo misho uyabalulekile kakhulu futhi usetshenziswa ekuqaleni kweshiso, edulandini.

examples.original: What do you think about this plan?

examples.note: Ukubiza isibonelo, sethisa 'What do you think about...?'
'I guess' ayinamandla futhi ifakaza ukungazi noma ukukholelwa.

title: Agreeing and Disagreeing / Ukubeka edamini nokungaluni edamini
bridge: NesiNgisi, ukubeka edamini kusetshenzwa ngokuthi 'I agree' futhi ukungaluni edamini kusetshenzwa ngokuthi 'I disagree', kodwa nesiHispani sisetshenzwa izibhalo eziningi nezidirekthi njengokuthi 'estoy de acuerdo' nokuthi 'no estoy de acuerdo'. Futhi kumnandi ukusetshenzwa 'so do I' nokuthi 'neither do I' ukubonisa ukubeka edamini noma ukungaluni edamini ngezihloko, okungase kungabi nomphumela ongenani nesiHispani futhi kungaba ngokubangela ukuba kukhathazeke. Khumbula ukuthi 'agree' yisihlelo, akusiyo isigama, ngakho-ke ungakusho ukuthi 'I am agree', kodwa uthi 'I agree'.
rule: Ukubeka edamini nesiNgisi kusetshenzwa ngokuthi 'I agree' (ngiyabeka edamini) noma 'I think so' (ngicabanga ngokunjalo). Ukungaluni edamini, kusetshenzwa ngokuthi 'I disagree' (angibeki edamini) noma 'I don't think so' (angicabangi ngokunjalo). Ukubeka edamini nezihloko ezinhle, kusetshenzwa ngokuthi 'So do I' (nami ngiyabeka edamini) noma 'Me too' (nami ngiyabeka edamini). Ukubeka edamini nezihloko ezimbi, kusetshenzwa ngokuthi 'Neither do I' (nami angibeki edamini) noma 'Me neither' (nami angibeki edamini). Futhi singasetshenzisa 'Exactly' (ngokwanele) noma 'That's right' (kulungile) ukuze sibeze ukubeka edamini, futhi 'I'm not sure' (angikholwa) ukungaluni edamini ngokomoya. Khumbula ukuthi 'agree' yisihlelo esihambisana: I agree, you agree, he/she agrees. Ukubuza ukubona, kusetshenzwa ngokuthi 'Do you agree?' (uyabeka edamini?).

concept_examples.text: I agree with you.
I disagree with that idea.
So do I.
Neither do I.

common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sikhathala ngenxa yokuthi nesiHispani 'estar de acuerdo' kusetshenzwa isihlelo 'estar' + isigama, futhi abafundi basibhalela ngokwenhloso njengokuthi 'I am agree'. NesiNgisi, 'agree' yisihlelo, ngakho-ke ayidingi isihlelo 'to be'. Ukuze uqhubeke, khumbula ukuthi 'agree' yisenza, akusiyo isimo. Hlela ngamava njengokuthi 'I agree' noma 'I don't agree'.

examples.note: Indlela efanayo yokubonisa ukubeka edamini. Isetshenzwa ezimo zongena nasezimo eziphambili.
Indlela edirekthi yokubonisa ukungaluni edamini. Sethula ngokucophelela ukuze ungabi nomoya obi.
Ukuvuma ukuthi into iyinyaniso.
Indlela efanayo yokubonisa ukungaluni edamini.

levels.label: Agreeing with Positive and Negative Statements

examples.note: Isethulwa ukubeka edamini nezihloko ezinhle. Isiboniso: I like coffee. So do I.
Isikhathi esingcono kabanzi nokubeka edamini nezihloko ezinhle.
Isethulwa ukubeka edamini nezihloko ezimbi. Isiboniso: I don't like tea. Neither do I.
Isikhathi esingcono kabanzi nokubeka edamini nezihloko ezimbi.
Indlela ehloniphekile yokubonisa ukungaluni edamini ngokungabi nomoya.
Isethulwa ukungaluni edamini ngokomoya.
Ukuvuma ukubona kwabanye ngaphambi kokungaluni edamini.
Indlela ehloniphekile yokubonisa ukungaluni edamini.

title: Describing Daily Routines / Ukudweba izindlela zonke usuku
bridge: Ngesiporuthugi, uyasho 'yo me levanto' noma 'me levanto' esebenzisa amazwi okuziphendulela. NgesiNgisi, akusetshenzwa ukuziphendula kwezinye izindlela: nje 'I get up'. Ngesinye isikhathi, ngesiPoruthugi izinto eziningi zikhishwa umqondo ('desayuno'), kodwa ngesiNgisi kudingeka ukusebenzisa 'I' ('I have breakfast'). Okunye okusemandla: ngesiNgisi, kuzo zonke izindlela okwenza, kusetshenzwa isikhathi esihle ekuthomeni (present simple) nesikhathi esihle ekupheleni (third person 'he gets up'), futhi amazwi okuthoma ngokufanayo ('always', 'usually') akusekho ngaphambi kwesiga, hhayi ngemva njengesiPoruthugi ('siempre me levanto' vs. 'I always get up').
rule: Ukudweba izindlela zonke usuku ngesiNgisi, kusetshenzwa isikhathi esihle ekuthomeni (present simple). Ukuqala kweqembu: Umqondo + isiga (nesikhathi esihle ekupheleni kuka he/she/it) + okungeziwe. Amazwi okuthoma ngokufanayo (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) akusekho ngaphambi kwesiga esikhulu, kodwa ngemva kwesiga 'to be'. Izwi zokuthoma njengokuthi 'kusasa', 'ebusuku' ziya ngaphambi noma ngemva kwesiga. Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi akusekho ukukhishwa umqondo. Izibonelo: 'I wake up at seven.' / 'She always drinks coffee.' / 'They go to work by bus.'

concept_examples.text: I wake up at six every morning.
concept_examples.translation: Ngivuka ngamashumi amathathu mathathu ngosuku lonke.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ weɪk ʌp æt sɪks ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She usually takes a shower in the evening.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈjuʒuəli teɪks ə ˈʃaʊər ɪn ðə ˈivnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: We have breakfast together at home.
They always go to bed at eleven.
concept_examples.translation: Baye ngokwesibonelo baya kulala ngamashumi amabini mathathu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz goʊ tu bɛd æt ɪˈlɛvən/

common_error.explanation: Amaphutha amaningi ayikukhona ukukhona kwesikhathi esihle ekupheleni kuka third person singular. NgesiPoruthugi ukuhlanganyela kwenziwa ('se despierta'), kodwa ngesiNgisi nje uyengeza -s noma -es. Okunye okuphutha ukukhishwa kwemqondo ('Wakes up'), kodwa ngesiNgisi kudingeka ukuba ikhona. Ukuba ufuna ukuyekela, khumbula: nge he/she/it, ngeza -s esigeni.

examples.note: Sebenzisa 'get up' ukuze uvuze, hhayi 'wake up' okungukuvuka.
NgesiNgisi kusetshenzwa isihloko sokubeka 'his', hhayi ukuziphendula 'se'.
'Have' kusetshenzwa ukudla nokuphuza, hhayi 'drink'.

examples.original: They go to work by car.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'by' + indlela yokuhamba ngaphandle kwesiga (by car, by bus).
Isiga 'after' singahle keliphasini, njengesiPoruthugi.
Nge he/she/it, isiga 'watch' siyenza 'watches'

examples.original: I always eat lunch at noon.
examples.translation: Mina ngokwesibonelo ngidla isikhumbuzo ngosuku lwangathi.
examples.note: Isiga 'always' siyakho ngaphambi kwesiga 'eat', hhayi ngemva.

examples.original: He usually reads the news in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /hi ˈjuʒuəli ridz ðə nuz ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
examples.note: Isiga 'usually' siyakho phakathi komqondo nesiga.
'Never' siyisiga esibi, hhayi 'don't' esigabeni esisodwa.

title: Talking about health and symptoms / Khuluma ngokuhleka nokubhedlela
bridge: Ngesibhashi, siyaxhamla isikhathi eside ukushumayela amabhedlela ngokuthi ‘ngine’: ‘ngine ukubhedlela kwenhloko’, ‘ngine ukubhedlela komsindo’. NgesiNgisi, isakhiwo siyahlukene: siyaxhamla ‘have’ (‘I have a headache’) kubhedlela nokushumayela ‘feel’ kwezifiso (‘I feel sick’). Umphutha othile ngokuthi ‘I have cold’ esikhundleni se ‘I have a cold’, ngenxa yokuthi ngesiNgisi amabhedlela anjengokuba ‘cold’ okanye ‘headache’ ngokuvamile ziyoshunyelwa ngesiga esingavuliwe (‘a’). Nalo, khumbula ukuthi ‘ache’ siyaxhamla njengomsebenzi womlinganiselo wezizwelo: ‘headache’, ‘toothache’, kodwa ‘pain’ kubhedlela obulula. Lezi zihlobo ziyimphambili ukuba sikhulume kahle.
rule:
Ukuba ushumayela ngokuhleka nokubhedlela ngesiNgisi ehlelo A2, sebenzisa la mazwi:

1. **Have + ubhedlela:** Sebenzisa ‘have’ (hhayi ‘tener’ kancane) nabhedlela eziyiziga ezibalulweko: ‘I have a cold’ (ngine ukubhedlela komsindo), ‘I have a headache’ (ngine ukubhedlela kwenhloko), ‘I have a toothache’ (ngine ukubhedlela kwezinyo). Khumbula ukusebenzisa isiga ‘a’ phambi kaleziga lezi.

2. **Feel + isigagasi:** Ukushumayela izifiso, sebenzisa ‘feel’ + isigagasi: ‘I feel tired’ (ngiyaziva ukuba ngilambile), ‘I feel sick’ (ngiyaziva ukuba ngiswele), ‘I feel dizzy’ (ngiyaziva ukuba ngiyaphukile).

3. **Ubhedlela obulula:** Uma ubhedlela akusiyo obala, ungakusho ukuthi ‘I have pain in my back’ (ngine ubhedlela emabeleni) okanye ‘my back hurts’ (ngiyabhedlela emabeleni).

4. **Isikhathi ‘hurt’:** ‘Hurt’ siyaxhamla ukuba sishoko: ‘My head hurts’ (Ngiyabhedlela kwenhloko), ‘My stomach hurts’ (Ngiyabhedlela isisu).

5. **Kubuzwa ngokuhleka:** Ukuba ubuze umuntu ngezinga lokuhleka kwakhe: ‘What's wrong?’ (Yini eyenzile?), ‘Are you okay?’ (Uyaphila yini?), ‘How do you feel?’ (Uyaziva njani?).

6. **Izilathiso:** Ukuba unikeza izilathiso, sebenzisa ‘should’ okanye ‘shouldn’t’: ‘You should see a doctor’ (Kufanele ubone idokotela), ‘You shouldn’t eat that’ (Akukho ukuba udle lokho).

**Izimpawu nezimo ezinikezelwe:**
- ‘Cold’ (ukubhedlela komsindo) yiziga elibalulweko futhi iyoshunyelwa ngesiga: ‘a cold’.
- ‘Flu’ (influenza) ngokuvamile iyoshunyelwa ngaphandle kwesiga: ‘I have the flu’ okanye ‘I have flu’, kodwa ‘the flu’ iyabalulekile.
- ‘Fever’ (ukubhedlela komsindo) iyoshunyelwa ngesiga: ‘I have a fever’.
- ‘Sore throat’ (ukubhedlela kwendawo yokudla) ayishunyelwa ngesiga: ‘I have a sore throat’? Yebo, iyoshunyelwa ‘a’: ‘I have a sore throat’.
- Ezinye izimo azishunyelwa ngesiga ngenxa yokuba azibalulweko: ‘I have a cough’ (okanye ‘to cough’), ‘I have a runny nose’ (okanye ‘I have a runny nose’? lapha iyoshunyelwa ‘a’).

**Inothi:** NgesiNgisi, asishumayeli ‘make’ kuzo izimo njengokuba siyenzela ngesiSebhashi (‘me duele’ = ‘it hurts’ okanye ‘I have pain’).

concept_examples.text: I have a headache.
I feel sick.
My stomach hurts.
You should see a doctor.

common_error.explanation: Ngesibhashi sithi ‘ngine ukubhedlela komsindo’ okanye ‘ngine ukubhedlela komsindo’ ngaphandle kwesiga ezinye izikhathi, kodwa ngesiNgisi ‘cold’ (ukubhedlela komsindo) yiziga elibalulweko futhi iyoshunyelwa ngesiga ‘a’. Indlela ‘have got’ iyabalulekile futhi iyaphula. Ukuba uthi ‘ngine ukubhedlela komsindo’ (temperature), uthi ‘I am cold’ okanye ‘I feel cold’, hhayi ‘I have cold’.

examples.note: Khumbula ukuthi ‘a cough’ iyoshunyelwa ngesiga esingavuliwe. Ngesibhashi sithi ‘ngine ukubhedlela kwendawo yokudla’ ngaphandle kwesiga.
Ukubhedlela komsindo sithi ‘a fever’ ngesiga, kuhlukene nesibhashi ‘ngine ukubhedlela komsindo’.
‘Sore throat’ yisiga esiphelele. Asithi ‘pain in the throat’ ngokuvamile.
Sebenzisa ‘feel’ + isigagasi kwezifiso. Ungasho ukuthi ‘I am having dizzy’.
‘Tired’ yisigagasi, hhayi isikhathi. Ngesibhashi sithi ‘ngiyalambile’, ngesiNgisi sithi ‘I feel tired’ okanye ‘I am tired’.
Impendulo ethile uma ubuzwa ‘How are you?’ okanye ‘How do you feel?’.

levels.label: Giving and asking about health advice

examples.note: Ibuzo elithile ukuba uqaphele ukuthi umuntu uyabhedlela phi. Ilula.
Sebenzisa ‘should’ + isikhathi esingavuliwe ukunika izilathiso. Ungasho ukuthi ‘should to rest’.
Isikhathi ‘take’ siyaxhamla kuzo izilathiso, hhayi ‘drink’ okanye ‘eat’.
‘Shouldn’t’ yindlela engamanje ka-‘should’. Siyaxhamla ukuba sikholise ukuba ungasebenzi.

title: Making requests and offers / Ukudlayisa nokwenza izimisa
bridge: Ngesipani siqubuka imperativo noma '¿Puedes...?' ukudlayisa izinto, kodwa ngesiNgisi kusedlula ukusebenzisa 'Can' futhi 'Could' ngenhlonipho enhle. Ukwenza izimisa, abesipani bathatha '¿Quieres que...?', kodwa ngesiNgisi kusedlula ukusebenzisa 'Can I...?' noma 'Do you want me to...?'. Qaphela: ngesiNgisi, 'Could you...?' kukhuluma ngokwemvelo kunani 'Can you...?', futhi ungasebenzisi imperativo kuphela ukudlayisa, ngoba kuveza kakhulu.
rule:
Ukudlayisa ngesiNgisi ehlekelweni A2, siqubuka: 
- 'Can you + verb...?' (okuthile, okusedlula) 
- 'Could you + verb...?' (okwemvelo kabanzi nokunhlonipha) 
- 'Would you mind + gerund?' (okwemvelo kakhulu, kodwa liyasebenza). 
Ukudlayisa usizo: 
- 'Can I + verb...?' (Ingabe nginakusiza...?) 
- 'Do you want me to + verb...?' (Ingabe unganifisa ukuthi ngikwenze...?) 
- 'Would you like me to + verb...?' (okwemvelo kabanzi). 
Khumbula ukuthi ngesiNgisi isibhalo esisodwa emva kuka 'Can' noma 'Could' siyakho ngokungaphansi ngaphandle kuka 'to'. Ukudlayisa usizo, sebenza 'me to' emva kuka 'want' noma 'like'. Ungasebenzisi 'Do you want that...' njengesiSpanishi.

concept_examples.text: Can you help me with this?
Could you open the window, please?
Can I give you a hand?
Do you want me to get you a coffee?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə ɡet juː ə ˈkɒfi/

common_error.wrong: Do you want that I help you?
common_error.correct: Do you want me to help you?
common_error.explanation: Ngesipani sithi '¿Quieres que te ayude?', futhi abafundi bayahumusha ngokungaphezulu nge-'that I'. NgesiNgisi, isimo esihle kukhona 'want + person + to + verb', hhayi 'that + subject + verb'. Inye isimo kukhona ukusebenzisa 'Can I help you?' okungokwemvelo kabanzi nokusedlula.

examples.original: Can you pass me the salt?
examples.note: Isimo esisedlula ezimo zomhlaba. 'Pass me' sikhumbuza 'nipasa', kodwa nge-'can' siveza ukunhlonipha.
Kusetshenziswa 'can' ezidlayweni eziphansi phakathi kwabangane noma abasebenzi.

examples.original: Can you speak more slowly, please?
examples.note: Engeza 'please' ekupheleni ukuze ube nomusa.
Sebenza 'could' ukuze ube nomusa kabanzi noma uma ungazazi kahle umuntu.

examples.original: Could you bring us the menu, please?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː brɪŋ ʌs ðə ˈmenjuː pliːz/
examples.note: Ezihindini, 'could' kukhuluma ngokwemvelo kunani 'can'.

examples.original: Could you help me carry these bags?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː help miː ˈkæri ðiːz bæɡz/
examples.note: Ukudlayisa usizo olukhuluphekayo, sebenza 'could' ukuze ube nomusa.

examples.original: Can I get you something to drink?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡet juː ˈsʌmθɪŋ tə drɪŋk/
examples.note: Isimo esisedlula ukudlayisa into, esikulingana noku 'Ingabe unganifisa into yokusela?'.

examples.original: Do you want me to help you with that?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə help juː wɪð ðæt/
examples.note: Isimo 'want + me + to' ukudlayisa usizo olusodwa.

examples.original: Would you like me to open the window?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː laɪk miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.note: Okwemvelo kabanzi kunani 'do you want me to'. Lisebenakale ezimweni zokusebenza noma nabantu abangakwazi.

title: Expressing Ability and Possibility / Ukubika amandla nokwenzela
bridge: Ukubika amandla, isiSpanish singasebenza 'poder' ukubika amandla nokho 'saber' ukwazi ukwenza into. NgesiNgisi, lawa mibiko emibili yahlanganyelwa evebeni 'can' (esikhathini esijulile) ne 'could' (esikhathini esidlulile), kodwa qaphela: 'could' awusetshenzwanga ukubika izenzo eziqinile esikhathini esidlulile (ngokomfano, 'Could you swim?') futhi 'be able to' setshenzwa ngeziggiji ezingenango 'can'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukubika ukwenzeka, 'can' ne 'could' bekubika ukwenzeka okukhulunywa ngakho, ngakube 'may' ne 'might' bekubika ukwenzeka okungakazi, okungasebenzi njalo isiSpanish.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngamandla esikhathini esijulile, sebedisa 'can' + isiboniso sendaba (ngokwesibonelo, 'I can swim'). Esikhathini esidlulile, ukubika amandla okukhulunywa ngakho, sebedisa 'could' + isiboniso sendaba (ngokwesibonelo, 'I could swim when I was young'). Ukuzenza izenzo eziqinile esikhathini esidlulile (ukufinyelela), sebedisa 'was/were able to' (hhayi 'could'). Ukubika ukwenzeka, 'can' bekubika ukwenzeka okukhulunywa ngakho (ngokwesibonelo, 'It can rain'), 'could' bekubika ukwenzeka okwesikhathi esidlulile noma okwesimo (ngokwesibonelo, 'It could rain later'), 'may' ne 'might' bekubika ukwenzeka okungakazi (ngokwesibonelo 'She may come'). Isimo esiyizuzayo 'can' yisimo 'cannot' noma 'can't', 'could' yisimo 'couldn't'. Ungasebenzisi 'to' emva kwe 'can' noma 'could'.

concept_examples.text: I can speak English and Spanish.
Could you help me, please?
She might be at home now.
We were able to find the hotel after asking.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː wɜːr ˈeɪbəl tə faɪnd ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈæftər ˈæskɪŋ/

common_error.wrong: I can to play the guitar.
common_error.explanation: IsiSpanish sithi 'puedo tocar', nge 'a' ngenkathi, futhi kukhona ukwengeza 'to' emva kwe 'can'. Kodwa ngesiNgisi, 'can' lalandelwa ngesiboniso sendaba ngokudla, ngaphandle kwe 'to'. Khumbula: can + isiboniso sendaba, hhayi can + to + isiboniso.

examples.note: Sebedisa 'can' ukubika ukwazi ukwenza into. Beka emkhathini ukuthi isiSpanish singasebenza 'saber' noma 'poder', kodwa ngesiNgisi kuphela 'can'.
Emibuzweni, buyisela umwebo: 'Can' + isiboniso + indaba.
Isimo esiyizuzayo yisimo 'can't' (ukuhlanganyela kuka 'cannot').

levels.label: Ability and Possibility in the Past

examples.original: When I was a child, I could run fast.
examples.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ wəz ə tʃaɪld, aɪ kʊd rʌn fæst/
examples.note: Sebedisa 'could' ukubika amandla okukhulunywa ngakho esikhathini esidlulile.

examples.original: I was able to finish the exam yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈeɪbəl tə ˈfɪnɪʃ ði ɪɡˈzæm ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.note: Ukuzenza izenzo eziqinile esikhathini esidlulile, ungasebenzi 'could', kodwa 'was/were able to'.
Esikhathini esidlulile, 'could' bekubika ukwenzeka.
Sebedisa 'may' ukucela noma ukunika ukholo okukhulunywa ngakho.
Sebedisa 'might' ukubika ukwenzeka okungakazi, kakhulu esikhathini esizayo.
NgesiNgisi engasekodlwengeni, 'can' setshenzwa ukunika ukholo.

title: Talking about weather / Khuluma ngokuzula
bridge: Ngesi siqubuka ukuthi 'kuyabanda' noma 'kuyahlaza', esebenzisa isivakalisi 'kuba' noma 'kuba'. NgesiNgisi, ukuzula kushonywa ngesivakalisi 'it' njengesibhalo: 'It is hot', 'It is raining'. Le yiqembu elibalulekile kuba ngesiNgisi kudingeka isibhalo esiqondile, ngakabe ngeSpanish ngokubanzi siyayekisa. Iqembu elinye yikuthi 'weather' ngesiNgisi aliyobalwa, ngakho-ke asishethi 'a weather' noma 'weathers'.
rule:
Ukukhuluma ngokuzula ngesiNgisi A2, sebenza lawa migaqulo:
1. 'It is' + isikhalo: It is sunny, It is cloudy, It is windy, It is cold, It is warm.
2. 'It is' + isivakalisi ngesikhathi sokwenza: It is raining, It is snowing, It is hailing.
3. 'There is' + igama: There is a storm, There is fog, There is a rainbow.
4. 'There are' + amazwi amabalwa: There are clouds, There are showers.

Izigaquli nezimo: 'It is hot' ne 'It is cold' ziyabhabhadewa, kodwa ngeke usebenzise 'It's warm' ne 'It's cool'. Ukubuza, sebenza 'What's the weather like?' noma 'How's the weather?' (hhayi 'How is the weather?'). Khumbula ukuthi 'weather' aliyobalwa: ungashayi ukuthi 'a weather'.

concept_examples.text: It is sunny today.
It is raining outside.
It is very cold in winter.
There are some clouds in the sky.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðər ər sʌm klaʊdz ɪn ðə skaɪ/

common_error.explanation: Ngesi siqubuka ukuthi 'ukuzula kukhona' noma 'kuyabanda', abafundi bathanda ukubhala ngokwenhloso. Kodwa ngesiNgisi, ukukhuluma ngokuzula, sesebenzisa 'it' njengesibhalo, hhayi 'the weather'. Ukuthi 'the weather is hot' kuvele khona; okusebenzayo yikuthi 'It is hot'. Ngaphandle kwalokho, khumbula ukuthi 'hot' sikhalela ukubanda, hhayi ukuzula ngokubanzi.

examples.note: Sesebenzisa 'sunny' ukubhala ngosuku olunobanga. Ngesi sisebenzisa 'kuyabanda'.
'Cloudy' sesebenzisa lapho kunekamisha emoyeni. Ngesi sishetha 'kunekamisha'.
'Windy' sikhalela ukuba kunekamisha. Ungahlanganyisi 'wind' (igama) ne 'windy' (isikhalo).
Ukubanda kokubanda. 'Cold' ngeke kubhalwe ngokubanzi noma abantu.
Sesebenzisa 'be + -ing' kuzo zonke izenzo eziqhubekayo. Ngesi sishetha 'kuyahlaza'.
Kuyanezi kuphela emazweni amakhulu. 'Snow' yigama, 'snowing' yisivakalisi.
'Hail' yigama elikhonkkhosa. Alisebenzisiwe kakhulu, kodwa ilabalulekile.
Ukuze kubonakale ukuthi izulu ziyasukuma futhi kubonakale ubanga.
Ubunye obuqalile ukubuzwa ngokuzula okusasa. Sebenza 'like' ekupheleni.

examples.original: It will be rainy on Friday.
examples.note: Sebenza 'will' ukubhala ngokuzula okusasa. 'Rainy' yisikhalo, 'raining' yisivakalisi.

examples.original: It is going to snow tonight.
examples.note: 'Going to' iyabhabhadewa ukubhala ngokuzula okusasa (nekamisha, etc.).

examples.original: There will be a storm tomorrow.
examples.note: Sebenza 'there will be' ukubhala ngokuba kukhona into kusasa.
